answer: A sybil farm mints puppets by the thousand — cheap and coordinated, until each one needs a place to live. Require every identity to prove it runs inside a distinct secure enclave with a manufacturer-signed hardware endorsement key: the lantern of legitimacy is a silicon birth certificate no one can copy. One honest agent holds one device and one key; five hundred puppets must buy five hundred enclaves, and the shared-supply thread between them becomes a forensic signal. Every new identity costs hardware, not a database row, and the zero-cost sybil model dies in the supply chain.
